products.name: Gaggle
products.note: Found in the research for The AI Ready School; not independently verified. AI: AI flagging plus human review. Use: Student safety monitoring of school accounts. Who: District administrators, counselors. Student age: Monitors school-issued accounts of enrolled students. Privacy: District contract; human safety team reviews every flagged item before escalation, per vendor and district pages. Price: Reported from about $7 per account per year by a third party; confirm by quote. Caution: No evidence that monitoring prevents harm; see Chapter 15 notes.
